summary: To set or place, especially beside fire. Psalm 22 pictures the sufferer being set in the dust of death, while Ezekiel and Isaiah use the root for what Yahweh establishes.

senses.definition: The speaker says that he is set in the dust of death.
Ezekiel commands the pot to be set on the fire, and Isaiah attributes established works to Yahweh.

note: The Psalm 22 form תִּשְׁפְּתֵנִי is a Qal imperfect with object suffix, “you set/place me”. Ezekiel 24:3 uses the same root for setting a cooking pot, and Isaiah 26:12 uses the related passive placement idea. The earlier morphology warning is resolved.
